title: Campfire
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, abandoned summer camp in deep winter, snow-buried log cabins, a frozen lake ringed by black pines, cold moonlight against warm firelight, adults only, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 3. A campfire is burning in the middle of the frozen lake. 🔥

Original fiction. Part 4 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Sam found a sign-in sheet with twelve counselors from 1981, and one blank line marked Caretaker.
scenes.image: a clipboard on a nail inside a dark log cabin, a pen swaying on a string

scenes.narration: He didn't sign it. He nailed cabin seven shut with two-by-fours. He slept with the lights on and a fire poker beside the bed.
scenes.image: a man hammering boards across a log cabin door in the snow at dusk
a man sitting up in a narrow bed in a cabin at night, lamp lit, eyes wide

scenes.narration: Not a radio. Voices. A dozen of them, young and loose and laughing, the way people sing when they're far from home and don't care who hears.
scenes.image: a dark snowy forest at night, warm orange light glowing between the trees

scenes.narration: It was coming from the lake. From somewhere far out on the ice, where nobody should be standing in February.
scenes.image: a frozen lake at midnight under a full moon, a glow far out on the ice

scenes.narration: Sam walked down to the shore in his boots and long johns. Out in the middle of the lake, a campfire was burning.
scenes.image: a campfire blazing in the middle of a vast frozen lake at night, sparks rising into the dark

scenes.narration: Fire, on ice. And the ice wasn't melting.
scenes.image: close-up of crackling flames resting directly on clear black lake ice, no water, no melt

scenes.narration: Twelve figures sat around it in old wool blankets, faces orange in the firelight, singing a camp song he had never heard, and somehow knew every word to.
scenes.image: silhouettes of young adults wrapped in wool blankets around a campfire on a frozen lake, backs to the camera

scenes.narration: The song ended. The broad-shouldered one, the one they called Moose, stood up and waved him over.
scenes.image: a broad-shouldered young man in a blanket standing beside a campfire on ice, raising one hand

scenes.narration: Then all twelve turned to look at Sam at once, and said, together: there you are.
scenes.image: twelve young adult faces turned toward the camera in firelight on a frozen lake at night, smiling
